packageRules.description: Patch and minor npm updates land unattended once CI is green. CI runs the full backend suite against a real Postgres, so a broken bump does not merge.
Majors are read by a human. They are where renames, dropped Node versions and changed defaults live.
Postgres majors are a dump-and-restore, not a container restart: the new image refuses to start against an old data directory. Held permanently; see docs/deployment.md.
Postgres patch releases are safe and worth taking promptly.
A Node major changes the runtime under the app and the base image at once. Manual, and it must be paired with the CI node-version.
Base image patch and minor updates are the point of running Renovate here: they are how CVEs in the OS layer get picked up.
GitHub Actions pinned by major tag; minor moves are noise.
esbuild is pinned exactly on purpose. Surface the update but never merge it unread.
